item.title: Iran names Ali Larijani's replacement, pledges 'complete victory'
item.description: The spokesman of Iran's top military command said on Tuesday, March 24, that its armed forces will fight “until complete victory.”

item.title: TGREDCO, GGGI join hands to accelerate push for energy-efficient buildings
item.description: The TGREDCO signed an MoU with the Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) to strengthen collaboration in energy efficiency in the state.

item.title: Two held for performing bike stunts near Telangana Secretariat
item.description: Saifabad police arrested two men for allegedly performing dangerous bike stunts near the premises of Telangana Secretariat and Lumbini Park.

item.title: Harish Rana passes away at AIIMS after landmark passive euthanasia ruling
item.description: Harish Rana, the first person in India to be allowed passive euthanasia, passed away at AIIMS-Delhi after more than 13 years in a coma

item.title: Secunderabad man without passing Class 10 posed as dentist for 20 years, held
item.description: A man posing as a dentist for nearly two decades was arrested in Secunderabad's Neredmet, after a raid by the Malkajgiri Police exposed his illegal clinic.

item.title: Last remaining Maoist commander Papa Rao surrenders in Chhattisgarh
item.description: One of the last remaining senior Maoist commanders, Papa Rao, surrendered along with his team members on Tuesday

item.title: Telangana ACB catches Khammam Motor Vehicle Inspector in Rs 24K bribe case
item.description: The Telangana Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) caught a Motor Vehicle Inspector (MVI) posted at Wyra in Khammam district for allegedly demanding a bribe.

item.title: Delimitation welcome in Telangana, but south should not be penalised: KTR
item.description: BRS leader KTR welcomed the long-pending delimitation process in Telangana but expressed concerns over its disadvantages to southern states.

item.description: The Golconda Task Force and Kulsumpura Police busted an unlicensed pickle manufacturing unit in Hyderabad's Jiyaguda area
